messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: model specification
parts:
Hi folk

Can any one help me to understand this model specification in lavaan?

lavaan.lsat6.2pl.model <-'
Theta =~ l1*Item_1 + l2*Item_2 + l3*Item_3 + l4*Item_4 + l5*Item_5
Item_1 | th1 *t1
Item_2 | th2 *t1
Item_3 | th3 *t1
Item_4 | th4 *t1
Item_5 | th5 *t1
'

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: model specification
parts:
See, for example, this guide--look at the section headed "Categorical Indicators"
https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrmda.dept.ku.edu%2Fguides%2F21.LavaanSyntaxGuide%2F21.LavaanSyntaxGuide.docx  
The last 5 lines of your syntax are assigning labels to the single threshold of each of the 5 apparently binary indicators. The syntax assigns different labels to each different threshold, so no constraints are being imposed.

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: model specification
parts:
The "i#" terms are also labels. They are all different, so no constraints are implied.
Broadly, you cannot assess identification without knowing whether the "lavaan" function or the "sem" or "cfa" functions will be used. "sem" and "cfa" contain more default settings that aid identification. The thresholds, however, will be identified from the raw data.
